Model: worksheet scenarios bear 30%→0.60x, base 47%→1.89x, bull 15%→3.30x with σ=0.35; reverse DCF base-case IRR 7.3%; card rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.59x anchored (raw 1.59x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). data.base_rate_reasoning: India non-financial, mcap Rs 1,000-20,000 cr at T, 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2016 and 30-Sep-2018 (survivorship-free, dead firms included, stratum-weighted). n=208 company-snapshots (54 distress-census D, 153 live L at weight 5.63, 1 delisted-other X at 4.26); 95% CIs (company bootstrap within stratum): P(>=3x) 14.1-28.7%, P(<=0.5x) 7.0-16.1%, P(blow-up) 10.2-21.4%. Two start dates only, and they disagree (2016: >=3x 16%, blow-up 21%; 2018: 26%, 10%). Price return only (no dividends, ~1%/yr). Blow-up = close <=0.2x the close at T, liquidation or compulsory delisting (no fraud field). Remaining survivorship leak toward FEWER failures (IBBI firms renamed/merged and 221 IBBI rows without identifiers missing; voluntary/merger delistings X under-covered). A survivors-only sample from the same frame says P(<=0.5x) 7% instead of 11%.
